goal.text: My goal     is to help people reconnect with themselves, restore the joy of life, and build a healthy mind.

reviews.title: What Clients Say
reviews.review1: I believe you’re an amazing psychologist who truly heals with words. You have a deep understanding of how the mind works. You’ve helped me uncover so much and prevented me from falling into complete exhaustion and confusion about my state. As a psychologist, you’re a wonderful professional — inspiring, gentle, and always careful not to hurt or disturb anyone, striving instead to help them remain in a stable state. It’s also very touching that you stay in touch even outside of working hours — it means a lot, especially during difficult times, no matter how awkward it might feel to ask for help.
reviews.review2: Good afternoon, Ms. Yulia. I apologize — our chat got lost among my work messages, and I completely forgot that I had promised to leave feedback. I really enjoyed working with you. I’m very grateful for your help and the advice you gave me. Most importantly, I heard from you not what I wanted to hear, but what I needed to hear.
reviews.review3: I’m very satisfied with our work together, Yulia. For a long time, I was troubled by thoughts that kept running through my mind over and over again. But after working with you, I was finally able to sort everything out and understand many things about myself.
reviews.review4: I kept postponing our meeting because I thought I could handle everything on my own. But after just a few sessions, I realized how much I really needed it. Thank you for opening my eyes to so many things, for helping me cope with everything, and for making me realize my true worth.
reviews.review5: Only after our sessions did I realize what it truly means to be heard. At first, it wasn’t easy, but each session opened something new about myself. Now I feel much calmer, and you’ve given me something I had been missing for a long time.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Can I reach out even if I don't have a clear request?
faq.a1: Yes. People often reach out just with a feeling that something is wrong, or when they want to understand themselves better. This is already a valid reason for a consultation.
faq.q2: What happens during the first consultation?
faq.a2: During the first consultation, we discuss your needs and expectations, agree on the format, and make arrangements for further work. We can also begin working on your requests right away.
faq.q3: How can I know how many consultations I'll need?
faq.a3: The number of consultations depends on your individual request and goals. Usually, the first few consultations help understand how much time may be needed.
faq.q4: Do I need to prepare for consultations?
faq.a4: No special preparation is needed. It’s only important to find a space where you won’t be disturbed. Sometimes, I may give home tasks that help reinforce the results.
